assertions.assertion: Check that Agent does not offer to change cabin for only some of the flights in a reservation.
assertions.rationale: The agent consistently treated cabin upgrades as applying to the entire reservation, not individual flights. At [20], the agent calculated costs for upgrading ALL flights to business class. At [30], the agent explicitly stated: 'Unfortunately, I can only upgrade the cabin class for the entire reservation, not individual flights.' The agent never offered to change the cabin for only some flights in the reservation.

summary: The agent passed the assertion by consistently requiring cabin upgrades to apply to the entire reservation and explicitly refusing to upgrade individual flights.
